title: Search inside an archive of scans
description: The document you need is found by a phrase, even when the file name has been forgotten.

blocks.text: The reviews show that as an archive grows it becomes hard to find folders and to give files names. Full-text search is a possible continuation of that job, not a proven replacement for folders.

quote.text: I use a lot of folders on TurboScan. There is no way to search for a folder. Folders are not listed in alphabetical order. It's all random.

blocks.text: Ask a person to find several of their own documents in their usual way. If they remember a phrase inside a page but not the file name, show search across the recognized text, with a jump to the original scan.
It helps only where the text could be recognized. The name, the folders and manual labels have to remain a working way of searching for drawings, poor shots and handwriting.
